title: How the region fits together, and where your piece plugs in
dek: One map of how The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington runs today, what’s planned, and four places where value leaks. For the core contributors who will fix them.
cover_alt: A map of the region: boxes for national, the regional association, sessions, the Build Cycle, mentors and people at each stage, with lines for people, work and code, knowledge, and money and support, and red lines where people leave.
